Detectors added Secret scanning now automatically detects the following new secret type in your repositories. Provider Secret type Cloudflare cloudflare_access_service_token Partner secrets are automatically reported to the secret issuer when found in public repositories through the secret scanning partnership program . User secrets generate secret scanning alerts when found in public or private repositories. Learn more Learn more about secret scanning and see the full list of supported secrets in our documentation. In your enterprise’s Public monitoring view, click an alert number to open the alert. You can use its URL to bookmark the finding or share it with teammates who have access. Public monitoring is available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers with GitHub Secret Protection or GitHub Advanced Security, at no additional cost.
